messages:
tony-sales: Heads-up — Brightline is kicking off an evaluation to move from AltAI -> Redwood. Top concerns: token billing parity, function-calls compatibility, streaming framing, and IP allowlist for their staging. Need a short checklist for POC next week.

liam-se: Quick checklist from presales: 1) canonical prompt bundle (they said ~120 templates), 2) an example of their function call schema, 3) traffic shape (qps + message lengths), 4) whether they rely on AltAI's "role:" field semantics.

nina-eng: Note on role semantics: AltAI treats assistant/system/user differently in token counting. We'll want to canonicalize by injecting a small shim that converts AltAI roles to Redwood's speaker labels and trims leading system tokens. Example transform: 

```
AltAI: {role: "system", content: "You are Helpful"} 
-> Redwood: {speaker: "system", text: "You are Helpful"} 
```

nina-eng: For function-calls: AltAI returns function call metadata inline under choices[].call. We can map to our /v1/functions/events output but need to confirm they expect typed args vs raw json.

cara-sec: Security asks came through: KMS BYOK, short retention for logs (30d), EU data residency, and a request for static egress IPs for staging. We can do BYOK on Enterprise; retention adjustable for Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can create a temporary NAT allocation for the POC but will need ops signoff.

maya-legal: Confirming we can provide a short-term IP SLA in an addendum. Also ask procurement if they require BCRs or SCCs for EU processing — that will affect timeline.

ben-ops: infra-bot: provisioning-request.received -> alloc-staging-1722. I can hold 4 static egress IPs for a 30-day window for the POC. Need contact email + start/end dates. Will also open a port for observability to their IPs.

liam-se: Important for billing: AltAI uses a different tokenizer and counts system+assistant tokens differently. We'll produce a "token delta" sheet: same prompt run on both sides with token counts + output length and estimated cost diff. Recommend we show 3 representative prompt types (short chat, multi-turn, long instruction).

nina-eng: On streaming: AltAI streams event frames like {type:"partial", token:"..."} while we stream SSE deltas. We'll implement a compatibility layer that reshapes our SSE into AltAI-style JSON frames for the POC. That should keep their frontend code working.

tony-sales: Customer asks for pricing parity — can we offer a temporary rebate or credit if billed tokens exceed their expected by >10% during the POC?

maya-legal: We can draft a POC credit clause limited to the trial window; need finance sign-off on caps. Keep it time-boxed.

cara-sec: Also call-out: they want request-level audit logs accessible via S3 export. Hosted can export logs but we need to enable a per-customer bucket with lifecycle rules. Ops, is that doable for a POC?

ben-ops: yes, we can create an S3 export to a customer-owned bucket or temp Redwood-managed bucket. For security, prefer customer-owned with a presigned write role. Will need their bucket ARN and IAM contact.

liam-se: Action items: - I'll pull the sample prompt bundle + function schemas - Nina: prototype shim and run 30 sample prompts to generate token delta + output diff - Cara: collate SOC2 + data flow diagram + discuss IP lease - Maya: draft POC addendum and short-term pricing credit language - Ben: reserve IPs and S3 export config

tony-sales: Target: kickoff in 6 business days. Can we have shim + delta report 2 days before kickoff?

nina-eng: We can do an initial shim and 30-prompt delta by 2 days pre-kickoff. Need their prompt pack by EOD Thu.

liam-se: I'll ask Brightline to upload prompts to the shared folder and send function schemas. Also will flag to them that we may normalize stop sequences which could change outputs slightly.

cara-sec: Security note - they require quarterly pen tests for production. POC won't need it but flag for roadmap.

infra-bot: provisioning-update: staging-cluster-1722 created (id stg-bright-1722). Credentials delivered to tony-sales 1:1.

tony-sales: Thanks all — I'll schedule the kickoff invite and add the customer infra contact. Please add any missing items to the thread. :rocket:
